name: collide
description: Dependency-collision scanner for npm projects — pluggable scanner modules over one core engine.

scripts.demo: tsx test/build-vuln-lab.ts test/.vuln-lab && FORCE_COLOR=1 tsx src/cli.ts scan test/.vuln-lab/package-lock.json
scripts.go-demo: tsx test/build-go-lab.ts test/.go-lab && COLLIDE_GOMODCACHE=test/.go-lab/modcache FORCE_COLOR=1 tsx src/cli.ts scan test/.go-lab/go.sum
